# dockercompose_network (Resource)

A standalone Docker network, created directly via `docker network create` rather than through any `dockercompose_stack`'s compose project. Use this when a network needs to be shared across multiple stacks: Compose prefixes every network declared inside a stack with `<project>_`, so two stacks can't join "the same" network just by declaring matching `network` blocks. Create the network here instead, then join it from each stack's `network` block with `external = true` and `external_name` set to this resource's `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    dockercompose = {
      source  = "xRizur/dockercompose"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

resource "dockercompose_network" "shared" {
  name       = "shared_net"
  driver     = "bridge"
  attachable = true

  ipam_subnet  = "172.28.0.0/16"
  ipam_gateway = "172.28.0.1"
}

resource "dockercompose_stack" "api" {
  name = "api-stack"

  service {
    name     = "api"
    image    = "myapp/api:latest"
    networks = ["shared_net"]
  }

  network {
    name          = "shared_net"
    external      = true
    external_name = dockercompose_network.shared.name
  }

  depends_on = [dockercompose_network.shared]
}

resource "dockercompose_stack" "worker" {
  name = "worker-stack"

  service {
    name     = "worker"
    image    = "myapp/worker:latest"
    networks = ["shared_net"]
  }

  network {
    name          = "shared_net"
    external      = true
    external_name = dockercompose_network.shared.name
  }

  depends_on = [dockercompose_network.shared]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Literal Docker network name (not project-prefixed).

### Optional

- `attachable` (Boolean) Allow manual container attachment (required for overlay networks joined by standalone containers).
- `driver` (String) Network driver (bridge, overlay, host, none). Defaults to bridge.
- `driver_opts` (Map of String) Driver-specific options.
- `internal` (Boolean) Restrict external access.
- `ipam_driver` (String) IPAM driver.
- `ipam_gateway` (String) IPAM gateway (e.g. '172.28.0.1').
- `ipam_subnet` (String) IPAM subnet (e.g. '172.28.0.0/16').
- `labels` (Map of String) Network labels.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Notes

- All attributes are `ForceNew`: changing any of them destroys and recreates the network. Docker networks aren't mutable in place, and this resource intentionally doesn't try to fake in-place updates around that.
- Destroying a `dockercompose_network` while a stack still references it (via `external = true`) will fail at the Docker engine level ("network has active endpoints"), not silently succeed. Use `depends_on` on each referencing stack, as shown above, so Terraform tears stacks down before the shared network.
